name: Namo Hanumate Rudravataraya
meaning: I bow to Lord Hanuman, the incarnation of Rudra, the son of Vayu, and the beloved devotee of Lord Rama.
note: Its wording includes subduing enemies and drawing others under one’s influence (vashikarana). It is a specialised text, not a general mantra, and it is held back from this page until Sarvakali decides whether it belongs here.
